messages.text:
Ivo proposes a fixed design fee of **$42,500 for a guaranteed block of 50 design days**, provided Hearth pays a 30% deposit within five business days of signing. That brings the rate to $850 per day. If Hearth needs a smaller commitment, Ivo can price an agreed number of days at the standard $900 daily rate.

The design package would include an exhibit concept, a developed layout addressing accessibility and touring requirements, and final design drawings and specifications for the fabricator. Hearth would provide one consolidated round of feedback at concept review and one at developed-design review. Any additional revisions or changes to the approved brief would need written agreement on cost and schedule.

The proposed payments are **$12,750 to reserve the block, $17,000 on delivery of the developed design, and $12,750 on delivery of the final design package**. Fabrication supervision is separate at $900 per day, with dates and any travel costs agreed in advance. Ivo would have permission to show photographs of the exhibit in their portfolio after the public opening, subject to agreed credit and photography restrictions.

Can Hearth confirm the fabrication-slot deadline, the date the fabricator needs final drawings, and any venue or accessibility requirements already set? With those dates, we can put the review windows and handoff into the agreement.

Hearth proposes **$41,400 for 46 guaranteed days at $900 per day**, including 44 design days and two on-site installation days. Hearth can pay **20% ($8,280) within five business days of signing**, then $8,280 on concept delivery, $12,420 on developed-design delivery, and $12,420 on final handoff. Please identify any site travel costs you would need covered so we can agree on an allowance before signing.

The concept would establish the visitor route and exhibit sequence. The developed design would include both the primary layout and an accessible alternate layout for a smaller touring venue, with circulation and access clearances shown on each. Hearth would provide one consolidated round of feedback within five business days of each delivery. The final handoff would include editable fabrication files in a format agreed with the fabricator, matching PDFs, and specifications for both layouts. Changes to the approved brief, extra revision rounds, or additional site days would require written agreement on price and timing.

Ivo would retain copyright and grant Hearth a perpetual, royalty-free license to fabricate, exhibit, tour, repair, and adapt the exhibit, including sharing editable files with fabricators and host venues for those purposes. Hearth would credit Ivo as exhibition designer. Ivo could use cleared photographs in their portfolio once the touring venue opens, currently expected two months after launch. Hearth would confirm the release date in writing.

The slot expiration, drawing deadline, installation dates, venue dimensions, and venue-specific accessibility requirements are still unconfirmed. Hearth proposes checking with the fabricator now on exactly what secures the slot and by when, then obtaining the host venues’ plans and access requirements. Can Ivo confirm the 46-day scope and payment terms and specify the working time needed for concept, developed design, and final drawings? With those lead times, we can work backward from the fabricator’s deadline and put the delivery, review, and installation dates in the agreement.

Ivo accepts the **$41,400 fee for 46 guaranteed days** and the proposed payment schedule. The agreement would allocate $39,600 to 44 design days and $1,800 to two on-site installation days. Ivo can commit to the site days once we agree their dates in writing. Any fabrication supervision outside those two days would require a separate booking at $900 per day.

Ivo can deliver both layouts within the following schedule:

| Stage | Ivo’s working time | Deliverable |
|---|---:|---|
| Concept | 10 design days from receipt of the deposit, approved brief, venue plans and access requirements | Visitor route and exhibit sequence |
| Developed design | 18 design days from receipt of consolidated concept feedback | Primary and smaller-venue layouts, with circulation and access clearances on each |
| Final handoff | 16 design days from receipt of consolidated developed-design feedback | Editable fabrication files in the format agreed with the fabricator, matching PDFs and specifications for both layouts |

Allow **54 business days from kickoff to handoff** if Hearth uses both five-business-day review windows and the design days run consecutively between reviews. The 44 design days include the two revision rounds. The four payments would be $8,280 within five business days of signing, $8,280 on concept delivery, $12,420 on developed-design delivery and $12,420 on final handoff.

For site travel, Hearth would cover round-trip economy transportation, local transfers, and lodging and meals if an overnight stay is needed. Once the site and dates are known, Ivo can quote a capped allowance before signing. Hearth would reimburse actual expenses up to that cap.

Ivo accepts the proposed license, editable-file sharing and designer credit. The remaining change is the portfolio release. Ivo proposes permission to show cleared photographs **from the exhibit’s first public opening**, even if the first touring stop opens later. Hearth can identify cleared images and required credits in writing ahead of launch.

Please confirm whether the first-opening release works for Hearth and check what secures the fabrication slot. With the drawing deadline and proposed installation dates, Ivo can confirm calendar availability against the schedule above.

The sponsor requires exhibit photographs to stay under embargo until the first touring venue opens, currently expected two months after launch. Hearth proposes clearing specific photographs and credits before launch so Ivo can post them as soon as Hearth confirms the touring opening in writing. If the opening moves, the release moves with it. Can Ivo accept that clause?

Hearth agrees to the $41,400 fee, the four payments, both accessible layouts, the editable-file handoff, and the license and credit terms. The 46 guaranteed days include two on-site installation days. Hearth also agrees to reimburse actual site travel expenses up to a separate cap agreed in writing before signing.

The fabrication slot remains unconfirmed. Hearth will ask the fabricator for the exact hold deadline, what action secures the slot, the final drawing deadline, and the installation window. We’ll use the 54-business-day schedule to check the latest viable kickoff against that deadline, then send Ivo the proposed stage dates, site, and two installation dates for availability confirmation and a capped travel quote.

Ivo can accept the sponsor’s embargo through the first touring opening, including a change in the opening date. Please identify the cleared photographs and required credits before launch and confirm the opening in writing on the day it occurs. Ivo may then use those photographs in their portfolio without further approval.

If the tour is cancelled, would Hearth request a written release from the sponsor for the cleared photographs? Ivo would await that release before posting.

The fee, milestones, scope, license and credit are agreed. Once Hearth sends the fabricator’s deadlines, stage dates, site and two proposed installation dates, Ivo can confirm availability and quote the travel cap for the agreement.

Yes. If the tour is cancelled, Hearth will promptly request a written release from the sponsor and forward it to Ivo if granted. Ivo may then use the photographs covered by the release, with the agreed credits. The embargo stays in effect unless the sponsor grants that release.

Hearth will identify the cleared photographs and required credits in writing before launch. On the day the first touring venue opens, Hearth will confirm the opening in writing. Ivo may then use those photographs in their portfolio without further approval.

The fabrication hold deadline, action required to secure the slot, and final drawing deadline are still unconfirmed. Once Hearth has those details, we’ll send the proposed stage dates, site, and two installation dates so Ivo can confirm availability and quote the travel cap before signing.
